title: Quiet landscapes
shortLine: Mist, still water and soft light.
description: Mist on the water, frozen lakes and the last light over a village. Eight paintings to slow down with.

title: Colour and light
shortLine: Paintings where colour does the talking.
description: A red band on ochre, embers in the dark, hibiscus in hard sun and a scarf that glows against a blue wall. Eight paintings led by colour.

title: Faith and devotion
shortLine: Sacred stories in gold, tempera and acrylic.
description: An angel under gold leaf, a stable lit from within and a father welcoming his son home. Eight paintings of faith, old and new.

title: Flowers in bloom
description: Peonies in a chipped jar, a single plum branch and sunflowers just past their best. Eight paintings of flowers in every season.

title: Faces and figures
shortLine: People at work, at rest and at play.
description: A drummer in the middle of a beat, a tailor under a bare bulb and a dancer tying her shoe. Eight paintings about people and the lives they lead.

title: Bold abstraction
shortLine: Shape, rhythm and colour without a subject.
description: Floating rectangles, folded planes and marks scraped back with a knife. Eight paintings that ask you to look at colour and shape for their own sake.
